2653-2893-7886-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Beorn's Hospitality trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Beorn's Hospitality trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

339-574-677-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-4359.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1453-4247-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4247-4694-7306.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-3337-5398.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2105-3337-5398.notablePrerequisites: Tesak can attack without taking damage.
2105-3337-5398.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Tesak and Combat Celebrant token as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
When you attack, Tesak and the Combat Celebrant token trigger.
Resolve the token's trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve Tesak's trigger, adding mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

728-2018-5263.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from steps 1 and 3
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7232-8095.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X tapped lands on the battlefield.
6972-7232-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-5147-6026.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.

876-7070-7908.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two Halflings.
876-7070-7908.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend The Notary Hobbits.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to The Notary Hobbits.
Activate The Notary Hobbits by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting The Notary Hobbits.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending The Notary Hobbits.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast The Notary Hobbits from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

341-1090-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

549-4017-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-4017-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1394-2060-5256-7038-7704.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Doc Samson.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Doc Samson.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

57-2341-4846-7296.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
Feldon isn't your commander.
57-2341-4846-7296.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

222-527-2292-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

1486-4452-5433--119.easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1486-4452-5433--119.description:
Tap a creature using any method.
Magda triggers, as the creature is a Dwarf due to Rukarumel, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat, tapping the Goblin instead.
1486-4452-5433--119.notes: The method used to tap creatures must be usable for all creatures you control for the loop to continue. You may use Krenko (or Magda if it doesn't have summoning sickness) to start the combo if they're untapped. Some methods may overt the summoning sickness requirement (like Earthcraft, for example).

57-283-4846-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-4846-7060.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-6723-6791-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-6791-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

6243-6288-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

252-1879-4871.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature and have a way to cause that creature to die.
252-1879-4871.description:
Kill any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

277-1168-1479-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1168-1479-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Toggo and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1525-2031-2406-2660-5241.notablePrerequisites:
Sakashima's Student is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5241.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-5241.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

708-2034-2459-4948.notablePrerequisites: Estrid's Invocation is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2034-2459-4948.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

2387-2457-2850-3129-3499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Whenever the Insects enter the battlefield, Ivy Lane Denizen triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each of them.
Activate the Ants by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1849-3259-3349.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1849-3259-3349.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, creating two Incubator artifact tokens with two +1/+1 counters on them.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the beginning of your next combat phase, Glissa triggers, transforming all Incubators you control into 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creatures.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3517-4659-4680.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
3517-4659-4680.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Tainted Observer triggers, causing you to pay {2} to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Tainted Observer.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrifcing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to proliferate.
Repeat from step 3.

1183-1628-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Pentavus.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-1628-4659.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
The Pentavite dies, triggering Pentavus, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.

1737-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least three charge counters.
1737-3492-3609.description:
Activate Magistrate's Scepter by tapping and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of Coretapper.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat.
